messages:
jasper.sales: Quick handoff to CS/Eng — AtlasWorks (research platform) went live on a small pilot yesterday. POC: miguel@atlasworks.org. Trial 30d, renewal in ~50d. Theyre worried about embedding accuracy drift vs competitors and unexpectedly high per-embedding cost at scale. Also saw SDK error on batch calls. Adding owners.

leila.cs: Ill own CS. Customer asks: 1) baseline embedding accuracy back-compare to the model we benchmarked, 2) SDK batch failure repro, 3) cost scenarios for bulk storage/retention. Could sales share repro + sample vectors?

jasper.sales: Uploaded logs & a small repro pack to ticket #77190. SDK error: `Error: invalid_chunk_size` when sending 10k vectors in a single batch. They also sent an eval set showing nearest-neighbor precision drop ~12% versus our initial demo.

tom.support: Picking up #77190. Quick triage: our batch API caps at 2k vectors per call; SDK should surface that more clearly. Short-term ask: enforce client-side chunking in SDK and return clearer 4xx with recommended chunk size. Attached minimal repro and sample request (JS snippet).

adele.eng: cc @tom.support @leila.cs  I can scope the runtime fix. Options: 1) server-side acceptance + streaming ingestion (larger change, ~5d), or 2) SDK validation + better 4xx messages (quick, ~24-48h). For cost, note that embedding storage policy + TTL affects quoted infra. Need expected daily ingest rate to size infra.

ryan.ml: From ML side: precision drop may be a model mismatch — their client is using a slightly different tokenizer/quantization setting. Ask: what model+tokenizer/hash did they run in prod vs demo? If mismatch, re-run eval with the exact served variant. I can re-run the eval if they share the exact commits.

leila.cs: Action items: CS=@leila.cs to coordinate repro with POC; Support=@tom.support to attach repro and propose SDK patch; Eng=@adele.eng to scope server vs SDK fix; ML=@ryan.ml to validate eval and re-run; Finance=@nina.finance to prepare embedding storage tiers. Next check-in tomorrow 10:00 PT.

nina.finance: Ill draft two retention tiers (30d vs 365d) and a bulk ingest discount schedule. ETA EOD tomorrow.

docs-bot: Note created: DOC-998 — clarify embedding batch limits and SDK examples.

deploy-bot: Ticket #77190 created by tom.support. SLA: 48h response requested.

leila.cs: Customer sentiment: Miguel called this a "deal-breaker" for scale. I scheduled an enablement call for tomorrow 11:00 PT to go over chunking and retention tradeoffs. I told them we wont commit to infra changes yet; first step is SDK fix + repro evaluation. Tagging owners: @adele.eng @tom.support @ryan.ml @nina.finance. :thumbsup:
